items: 3 Packages Shipping - The modular sectional sofa is delivered in 3 separate boxes and may arrive at different times. If you have any questions or need help with your cloud couch, please feel free to reach out to us.

Soft Chenille Fabric - Different from other corduroy materials, our modular sofa is made of chenille fabric. It is soft to the touch and looks luxurious, making your living room look more beautiful. At the same time, chenille fabric is scratch-resistant and durable, and will not pill, which greatly increases floor couch service life and indirectly saves you more living costs!

Oversized - This 130-inch modular sectional sofa not only makes your home look luxurious, but it also has 10" wide armrests, which allows you to place your tablet, snacks or drinks while relaxing your arms, adding more functionality to your leisure experience. In addition, this compression sofa also has an incredible 27.56-inch seat depth and 30D high-density sponge. The high rebound performance and wide seat depth greatly improve its cost-effectiveness.

Multifunctional Use, Modular Design - This compression sofa set consists of 6 small modular sofas, which greatly improves its flexibility. Not only can it be easily moved and reconfigured, suitable for various places such as living rooms, bedrooms or apartments, but its splicing function makes it no longer just an ordinary sofa, it can also be transformed into a comfortable sleeper sofa to provide additional sleeping space. Not only practical, but also beautiful and generous, how attractive!

No Assembly Required, More Stable - When you receive this cloud modular sofa, it has been fully compressed. You only need to open the box and packaging and gently tap each part to speed it back to its original state. (Normally, natural recovery takes about 72 hours) This can greatly save your assembly time and enjoy a brand new sofa faster. At the same time, the bottom of the Sectional sofa has anti-skid particles to prevent sliding, ensure a stable fixation, and be safer to use.

Recyclable Materials - Our floor modular sofa set uses traditional sewing techniques without glue, making it healthier and harmless. In addition, 99% of the fabric and sponge of the compressed sofa are recyclable, reducing the burden on the environment.
